findings.what: The dropped face tripo_part_12 sat inside a feathered hood of the torso part tripo_part_1 (neck column behind the head up to z 0.534 source). Without the face the hood is hollow: a bald dome behind the crest from the game camera and an open cavity from behind. Trimmed and capped (repair.trim, repair.caps, repair.patches).

The Tripo parts are one surface cut into parts; the per-part decimation opened sub-millimetre cracks along the shared cuts, visible with one-sided materials as 1-3 px background pinholes in game frames. Stitching (lowpoly.stitch) closes most of them; 50 px over 36 frames remain (see revision.verified_defects_fixed V1-NECK-SEE-THROUGH).

Tripo gave both ankles a gold band (the concept has one, on the left leg). The right band (tripo_part_11, a separate part) is kept: it bridges a 2.2 cm source gap between the right shin and tarsus; dropping it opened the leg.
The thighs are asymmetric: the left bulges forward (source y to -0.133), the right backward (to +0.072); knees are placed inside each thigh's mass.

Tripo PBR left the gold bands non-metallic (0 texels with metallic > 0.5); a colour rule (textures.metal_rule) sets metallic 1 / roughness 0.35 on the gold texels of the two band-carrying parts (proposal).
